note: Shared by the page's tests (tests/web/logic.test.mjs section 'The contract vectors', landed in P5a) and the backend's (tests/schema/test_contract.py). `requests`: valid ones marked `golden` with a name are exactly what the page builds for the project in the page test; `"golden": false` marks a vector written by hand, which P5a flips once its builders agree; the rest are mistakes the backend must refuse. `replies`: what the backend may send; the page must read every valid one and refuse every invalid one. Cases where the two sides are deliberately not equally strict (extra keys, values of the wrong kind for a particular card) are left out.

project_notes.note: What the page keeps in the project file about what the model said. The page's own code builds these (tests/web/modelnotes.test.mjs, ids aside) and the Pydantic models accept them (tests/schema/test_project.py), so the two agree on the shape. A chapter's note holds the changes the page applied and what it noticed; the end note holds only the problem count and a fingerprint of the chapters the end copy was made from.
